description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call -- prices a proposed AI Alert pack WITHOUT spending any credits or creating anything. Supports a single alert, a handful, or the full set of 7: pass `alerts` with only the keys you want (e.g. one entry to create just one alert), or omit `alerts` entirely for the full 7-alert pack. Requires `characterImageUrl` -- your own uploaded/generated character (see generate_alert_character). Returns a planId (valid 24 hours, single-use) plus the exact credit cost -- show that to the user and get confirmation before calling create_alert_pack with this planId.

alerts.description: Which alerts to include. Omit this field entirely for the full 7-alert pack. If provided, ONLY the keys listed here are created -- e.g. a single {key:"follow"} entry creates exactly one alert. Call list_alert_types first for the valid keys.

enabled.description: Defaults true. Set false to exclude a key you listed.

miniPrompt.description: Extra creative direction for just this alert, up to 160 characters.

tier.description: Per-alert render tier -- Standard (Kling 3 Standard) or Pro (Kling 3 Pro). Defaults to standard.

title.description: Custom on-screen title, up to 40 characters.

captionColor.description: #RRGGBB fill for every alert's on-screen caption text (applies to the whole pack, not per-alert). Falls back automatically if too close to the character's chroma-key colour.

characterImageUrl.description: Your own character image: the path/url returned by generate_alert_character (once complete) or your own upload, or a safe https:// URL. Required.

paletteHexes.description: Up to 8 #RRGGBB colours to steer the pack's look.

theme.description: Overall visual theme/direction for every alert, up to 400 characters.

name: plan_alert_pack
title: Plan an AI Alert pack
